messages:
sara (ux): Quick design sync: the on-prem setup wizard has a very long prereq list that pushes key CTAs off-screen on 13" laptops. Proposal: compact collapsible rows with one-line summary + severity icon.
tom (eng): Sounds good. Backend can return a short summary and a diagToken so frontend doesn't parse logs. We'll add fields: summary, severity, diagToken.
maria (product): Tone: use calm, actionable copy. Avoid 'failed' as primary state. Suggest: 'Could not reach host on port 443. Check firewall or security rules.'
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) Toggle buttons need aria-expanded & aria-controls. 2) Use aria-live="polite" for status updates. 3) When opening the diagnostic drawer set initial focus to the heading.
devops-bot: Probe entry: 2026-03-23T09:12Z host=10.4.5.6 port=443 result=refused attempts=3
lee (qa): Tests: keyboard toggle (Enter/Space), focus order after opening drawer, and ensure mark-as-resolved is local only. Also verify analytics contains diagToken but no raw IPs.
sara (ux): Visual nit: pill icon-only fails contrast. Use text+icon pill and ensure AA contrast. I'll update tokens in the system file.
tom (eng): Implementation notes: debounce status updates to 250ms to avoid reflow. Non-modal drawer for diagnostics (initial focus but no focus trap).
maria (product): Copy variants to A/B: ["Could not reach host on port 443. Check firewall or security groups.", "Connection blocked on port 443. Verify rules.", "We couldn't connect. Open troubleshooting guide."] Leaning to first + a short guide link.
sara (ux): OK will update Figma and push frames. Fig link: https://figma.com/file/example-prereq-cards
lee (qa): I'll add e2e cases once PR lands.
maria (product): Plan: ship collapsible checklist + diag drawer + aria fixes next sprint. Thanks! :rocket:
